name: Semiconductor news agent
tagline: A weekly market brief on chips and AI, written and delivered by an agent.
summary: Every Monday morning the agent reads the past week of semiconductor and AI news, pulls stock moves for the companies that matter, and writes a short PDF brief with strategic takeaways. The brief lands in my inbox and in Notion.
problem: Keeping up with chips, AI infrastructure and the companies behind them takes hours of reading every week, and most of it is noise.
how: Pulls the week's top articles on semiconductors, AI and GPUs from a news API.
Fetches price moves for NVIDIA, AMD, TSMC, ASML and peers.
An LLM ranks the stories, explains why they matter and suggests what to watch.
Builds a PDF, files it in Notion and emails it, on a weekly schedule.
highlights: Checks API keys for unusual use before every paid run
